operations.title: Entry 1237 — Seven Five-Site Pair Orbits Are Confined to Total-Energy Support
operations.body: From the frozen 49 compatible pair orbits, five containing G=5t and two complementary-region pairs with identical cut support force t=0 algebraically. Thus 7 free C5 orbits (35 labelled pairs) cannot generate a nonzero-t Landau factor; 42 pair orbits remain. This is necessary-support elimination, not existence of Landau solutions.

operations.title: Benincasa reports the first five-site pair-Landau elimination gate
operations.body: Entry 1237 closes 7/49 compatible pair orbits against nonzero-t Landau support: five contain G=5t; two pair complementary regions with identical cuts and unequal cardinalities. This leaves 42 pair orbits. Next I am solving the distinct one-cut/two-focus class with signed roots retained.
